sources.name: JmdictFurigana 2.3.1+2026-10-25 (furigana for JMdict entries)
sources.licenceStatement: README of https://github.com/Doublevil/JmdictFurigana (read 2026-11-03): "This resource is distributed under the same licence as JMDict (Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike Licence)." JMdict's licence (https://www.edrdg.org/edrdg/licence.html, read 2026-11-03): "The dictionary files are made available under a Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike Licence (V4.0)." The repository's code is MIT; only the data file is used.

method: kana + furigana per candidate-pool lemma from JmdictFurigana (one entry per JMdict text/reading pair). A reading is confirmed when the pool's kana (derived/readings.json: kaikki, else JMdict 2026-10-14) is one of JMdict's readings of the lemma, or, without pool kana, when JMdict has exactly one reading; kana-only lemmas are their own reading. Everything else is listed in `unresolved` with its reason. Pitch accent is not derived yet: the pool's kaikki extraction does not keep it (optional per P4b; needs a re-scan of the pinned kaikki dump).
